articles.summary: Dinesafe.org Founder and CEO Patrick Quade joined the Oklahoma Society of Environmental Health Professionals (OSEHP) for its 72nd Annual Educational Conference, held October 21–22, 2026, at the Osage Casino Hotel in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The conference brought together environmental health professionals, public health officials, and industry experts to discuss current challenges and developments in environmental and food safety.
articles.title: Dinesafe.org Joins Oklahoma's Environmental Health Professionals in Tulsa
